_readme: DATA, hand-edited: the 'Always free' block on /free-events/ (write_hubs() in scripts/fetch_events.py, rendered by _free_places_html()). /free-events/ is the site's most-shown page in Search Console but sat around position 42 for 'free things to do in dallas' (2026-11-25 audit): it carried nothing but that day's listings, and the pages outranking it list places that are free every day. ONLY places whose admission is free every open day -- not 'free first Sunday', not 'free with a donation of $X'. State the catch when there is one (special exhibitions ticketed, no drive on holidays). Keep notes free of hours and prices that change; link the place's own site for those. `district` must be a slug in DISTRICTS, and is linked to that district page. `group` decides the heading. Verified 2026-11-25 against each museum's own site or local press.

places.name: Dallas Museum of Art
places.note: Free general admission; special exhibitions are ticketed.

places.name: Crow Museum of Asian Art
places.note: Free admission, in the Arts District and at UT Dallas.

places.name: Klyde Warren Park
places.note: Deck park over Woodall Rodgers Freeway, with food trucks and regular free programming.

places.name: African American Museum
places.note: Free admission at Fair Park, with free parking outside State Fair season.

places.name: Pioneer Plaza
places.note: Forty-nine bronze longhorns and their trail riders, downtown by the convention center.

places.name: Deep Ellum murals
places.note: Blocks of street murals, free to walk any time.

places.name: Katy Trail
places.note: Paved trail on an old rail line through Uptown, about 3.5 miles.

places.name: White Rock Lake
places.note: A loop of about 9 miles around the lake for walking, running and biking.

places.name: Fort Worth Herd Cattle Drive
places.note: Longhorns down East Exchange Avenue daily at 11:30 AM and 4 PM, weather permitting; none on Thanksgiving, Christmas or Easter.

places.name: Kimbell Art Museum
places.note: The permanent collection is free; special exhibitions are ticketed.
